header.name: Tata Steel Ltd
header.source: NSE closing price (end of day, not live); 52-week range computed from daily highs and lows (NSE bhavcopy)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Tata Steel (NSE: TATASTEEL), part of the Tata Group, makes and sells steel, with operations in India, the Netherlands and the UK; its consolidated revenue in FY26 was ₹2,32,140 crore.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: In the quarter to 30 Sep 2026, revenue was ₹65,436 crore, 11.5% more than a year earlier; the operating margin was 10.3% against 10.2%, and profit attributable to shareholders was ₹3,666 crore, 18.2% higher.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: On 8 Nov 2026, a Sunday special session and the first session after the result, TATASTEEL shares rose 2.09% while the NIFTY 50 fell 0.18% and the NIFTY METAL index rose 0.35%; allowing for the market's move, TATASTEEL's own move was +2.25%, about 1.65 times its usual daily variation.

claims.label: UNCERTAIN
claims.text: These numbers measure the move, not its cause: the result, the metals sector's rise and any other news that day overlap, and nothing here separates them.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: Neither discounted cash flow template used on this site applies to TATASTEEL: Template A needs free cash flow to the firm to be positive in at least three of the last four years, and it was not computable in FY23, FY24 and FY25, where the effective tax rate was outside the range the template accepts, so no model value is shown.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: At ₹163 (NSE close, 23 Nov 2026), the shares traded at 17.5× the profit attributable to shareholders over the last four reported quarters.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: Free cash flow to the firm was ₹4,397 crore in FY26; Template A would apply once it has been positive in three of the last four years, and the Q3 FY27 result will be the next reported quarter.

prices.note: Each series is rebased to 100 on the first common session. Raw exchange prices are not published here (NSE terms).

metrics.label: Market cap
metrics.definition: Price × shares outstanding (share capital ÷ ₹1 face value at 2026-03-31).

metrics.label: P/E (TTM)
metrics.definition: Price ÷ earnings per share over the last four reported quarters (Q3 FY26 – Q2 FY27).

metrics.label: EV / EBIT (TTM)
metrics.definition: Enterprise value (market cap − the net cash and treasury figure below) ÷ operating profit over the last four quarters.

metrics.label: Net cash and treasury
metrics.definition: Cash, bank balances and treasury investments, plus investments in joint ventures and associates, less lease liabilities, borrowings, preference shares and minority interests, at 31 Mar 2026.

metrics.label: Operating margin (FY26)
metrics.definition: EBIT ÷ revenue, after depreciation, excluding other income. Sites that quote an EBITDA-based margin show a higher figure.

metrics.label: ROE (FY26)
metrics.definition: Profit for the year ÷ total equity at year end.

metrics.label: ROIC (FY26)
metrics.definition: After-tax EBIT ÷ invested capital at the start of the year. Invested capital excludes about ₹15k crore of cash and treasury.

metrics.label: Revenue growth FY22–FY26
metrics.definition: Compound annual growth of revenue from FY22 to FY26.

metrics.label: Cash conversion (FY26)
metrics.definition: Operating cash flow ÷ profit for the year.

metrics.label: Beta vs NIFTY 50
metrics.definition: Sensitivity of TATASTEEL's daily return to the NIFTY 50's, over the two years to the price date.
